policies.title: São Tomé and Príncipe ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule requires São Tomé and Príncipe visitors to obtain a visa before travel.
conditions: Applies to a São Tomé and Príncipe ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: São Tomé and Príncipe ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says São Tomé and Príncipe visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to a São Tomé and Príncipe ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: São Tomé and Príncipe ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule lists São Tomé and Príncipe in its No Visa Required cohort.
conditions: Applies to a São Tomé and Príncipe ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
The Embassy page uses the legacy English rendering Saint Thomas and Prince for São Tomé and Príncipe.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
